caseName: Cincinnati Bell Telephone Co. v. Public Utilities Commission
caseNameFull: Cincinnati Bell Telephone Co. v. Public Utilities Commission of Ohio

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. Ohio. Motion of GTE Service Corp. for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Appeal dismissed for want of substantial federal question.

Justice Powell and Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and this case.
